_comment: SHAPE REFERENCE ONLY — do not fill this copy in. The real per-machine vault pointer lives OUTSIDE the vault at ~/.aios/config.json, and the aios-notes one-time init command writes it for you. It is kept outside the vault deliberately: it holds an absolute path that differs on every machine (usernames differ), so it must never travel with the repo. A stray .aios/config.json inside the vault is gitignored as a safety net — if one exists, it is stale and the pointer at ~/.aios/config.json wins.
